from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/workspaces/semio')
repl={
'kit_metabolism.json':'metabolism.kit.semio.json',
'diff_kit_metabolism_inverted.json':'metabolism.kit.diff.inverted.semio.json',
'diff_kit_metabolism.json':'metabolism.kit.diff.semio.json',
'kit_metabolism_diffed.json':'metabolism.kit.diffed.semio.json',
'kit_invalid.json':'invalid.kit.semio.json',
'model_selection.json':'model.selection.semio.json',
'model-kpi-nakagin.json':'nakagin.kpi.model.semio.json',
'drag/diff_design_free.json':'drag/diff.design.free.semio.json',
'drag/diff_design.json':'drag/diff.design.semio.json',
'drag/design.json':'drag/design.semio.json',
'drag/pieces.json':'drag/pieces.semio.json',
'drag/offset.json':'drag/offset.semio.json',
'validation.json':'validation.semio.json',
'metabolism/.semio/kit.json':'metabolism.kit.embedded.semio.json',
}
paths=[]
for base in [root/'semio', root/'repo/vscode']:
    for p in base.rglob('*'):
        if p.is_file() and p.suffix.lower() in {'.ts','.tsx','.js','.jsx','.py','.go','.rs','.cs','.json','.md'}:
            paths.append(p)
changed=0
for p in paths:
    try:
        s=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    except Exception:
        continue
    ns=s
    for a,b in repl.items():
        ns=ns.replace(a,b)
    if ns!=s:
        p.write_text(ns,encoding='utf-8')
        changed+=1
print('changed_files',changed)
PY
